coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 block-cipher-mode 这一层：ECB/CBC/CFB/OFB/CTR/GCM 如何把分组密码用于多块数据，以及 IV、nonce、填充与认证边界；不把具体模式、AES、协议或事件并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the block-cipher-mode layer: how ECB/CBC/CFB/OFB/CTR/GCM apply a block cipher to multi-block data, and the boundaries of IVs, nonces, padding and authentication. It does not absorb individual modes, AES, protocols or events.
